topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I opened the door to the weight of an unfamiliar package, its label a faded map leading nowhere I recognize. In my hands, it feels like the world shrinks, pressing in. The air is thick with echoes of someone else’s life, their name a whispered reminder of the place I stand in, borrowed and temporary. I scan the room, each corner shadowed with the ghost of another's presence, wondering how to unwrap this mistake, this parcel of someone else’s story. The clock ticks, a relentless drumbeat, as I stare at the box, unopened, a bridge to a past I never lived, yet feeling the weight of it as if it’s my own legacy to deal with.
